questions.question: When was metformin first prescribed, and what was the initial dose and timing?
What other medications were the patient taking before starting metformin that might interact or contribute to stomach upset?
Has the patient reported stomach upset or gastrointestinal side effects with metformin in prior encounters?
Was any plan made to adjust, reduce, or discontinue metformin due to stomach upset, or to trial extended-release formulation?
Were any diagnostic tests (e.g., renal function, HbA1c) ordered or performed around the time metformin was started?
Was type 2 diabetes diagnosis confirmed with supporting lab results or criteria before metformin initiation?
